data.name: Dweomercraft
data.description: A magician can use performance to manipulate magical energies. Allies of the magician gain a +%1 bonus on caster level checks, concentration checks, and attack rolls with spells and spell-like abilities. This bonus increases by +1 at 5th level and every six levels thereafter. This ability relies on visual and audible components. It replaces inspire courage.|(BardLVL/5)+1
